To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the F5-motifs of GLUT4 and GLUT1 are sufficient to direct the transport of GLUT1 to the GSC, but that the LL489/90 motif of GLUT4 is required for the transport of GLUT4 into the GSC.
the N-termini of the GLUT4 isoform are not required for insulin-stimulated GLUT4 exocytosis.
the N-termini of the GLUT4 glucose transporters are involved in endocytotic trafficking of GLUT4.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of these two amino acids motifs in the trafficking of GLUT4.
the role of the C-termini in the endocytic trafficking of the GLUT4 glucose transporter.
the elucidation of the role of the N-termini and C-termini for the subcelluar trafficking of GLUT4 in adipose cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the N-terminal F-5 motif is not essential for the targeting of GLUT4 to intracellular compartments, and that the C-terminal LL-489/490-motif plays a major role in the endocytosis of the glucose transporter, whereas it does not seem to be involved in the exocytosis.
the N-termini of the GLUT4 are important for the subcellu-lar targeting, whereas the C-termini are responsible for the recycling of GLUT4.
the F5-motiv is necessary for GLUT4 targeting to the GSC, whereas the LL489/90 motif is necessary for GLUT 4 recycling.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the F5-motiv in the N- terminus is necessary and sufficient for the insulin-regulated trafficking of GLUT4 in adipose cells, whereas the C-termini are involved in the constitutive trafficking of GLUT4.
the N-terminal motif (F5) is important for endocytosis, while the C-terminal motif (LL489/490) is important for exocytosis.

the N-terminal F-5 and the C-terminal dileucine motif of GLUT4 are both required for the insulin-stimulated translocation, and that the N-termini of the GLUT4 isoforms are not sufficient to confer the correct subcellular distribution of GLUT4 in adipose cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the C-terminal LL-motif is essential for the endocytosis of the GLUT4, whereas the N-terminal F-motif is not.
the C-termini are involved in the internalization of GLUT4, but not in the recycling of GLUT4.
we were able to show that the C-terminal dileucine motif is important for the recycling of GLUT4, whereas the N-terminal phenylalanine is not.
